# Agentic Security Arsenal

> A modular security capability toolkit for AI agents and human security practitioners. It is not an autonomous pentester.

## Start here
- [README](README.md): product overview and CLI quick start
- [Agent quick start](docs/QUICKSTART_AGENTS.md): skill discovery and integration
- [Skills catalogue](docs/SKILLS.md): all skills and parallel-use guidance
- [Human user guide](docs/USER_GUIDE.md): installation and usage
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE_V1_6.md): design and source of truth
- [Evidence contract](docs/RESULT_CONTRACT.md): structured handoff format
- [Authorization](AUTHORIZATION.md): scope and permission rules
- [Security policy](SECURITY.md): responsible disclosure

## Skills
- [Portable skill folders](skills/README.md)
- [Scope authorization](skills/scope-authorization/SKILL.md)
- [MCP server review](skills/mcp-server-review/SKILL.md)
- [OpenAPI review](skills/openapi-review/SKILL.md)
- [Scanner triage](skills/scanner-results-triage/SKILL.md)

## Interfaces
- CLI: `agentsec`
- MCP stdio server: `agentsec mcp-serve`
- Python API: `agentsec.agent_api`
